findings.title: CORS preflight does not allow this origin
findings.explanation: The browser sent a preflight from https://app.example.org but the server only allows https://app.example.com. The browser will block the actual request.
findings.suggested_fix: Add https://app.example.org to the server's Access-Control-Allow-Origin list, or use a proxy with the correct origin.

findings.title: CORS response missing requested header in allow-list
findings.explanation: The preflight asked permission for Authorization, but the server only allows Content-Type. The Authorization header will be stripped or the request blocked.
findings.suggested_fix: Add Authorization to the server's Access-Control-Allow-Headers value.
